{{Quote|My name's Jaffkee. I'm with Republic security.|CSF Agent Jaffkee|<ref name="SWTORnoise" />}}
'''Jaffkee''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. At that [[Time/Legends|time]], [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] Jaffkee served as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. He was assigned to the [[Justicar territory|Justicars' Sector]] and was tasked with setting up [[Listening device/Legends|listening devices]] and communications to monitor the [[Justicars' Brigade]] [[Militia/Legends|militia]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Republic security hoped the Justicars would work alongside our officers&mdash;bring order to Coruscant's lower levels. But they pushed out Republic forces just like they did the criminals&hellip; They keep the peace down here, but they definitely aren't on the Republic's side.|Agent Jaffkee|<ref name="SWTORnoise" />}}
A young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Jaffkee lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He became a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]], which, at the [[Time/Legends|time]], had undergone severe hardships.<ref name="SWTORnoise" /> The Imperial [[Sacking of Coruscant]] and the immediate aftermath of rioting and looting had drained the CSF in lives [[Death/Legends|lost]] and in resources.<ref name="SWTORcsf">{{TORcite|type=codex|Coruscant Security}}</ref> [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|Police]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] were unable to prevent [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Thug/Legends|thugs]] from claiming complete control of various [[Black Sun territory|sectors]] as their own. The formation of the [[Justicars' Brigade]] [[Militia/Legends|militia]] in response to that had at first been greeted with enthusiasm by the CSF, including Jaffkee. However, the Justicars quickly established themselves as outside of Republic influence and brutally expelled both Black Sun and the CSF.<ref name="SWTORnoise" />

At one point, Jaffkee had a run-in with several Justicars and barely managed to escape with his life.<ref name="SWTORnoise" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="SWTORdate">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Jaffkee had attained the [[Police rank|rank]] of [[Agent/Legends|agent]] and was sent as an undercover operative to the [[Justicar territory|Justicars' Sector]] to try to plant [[Listening device/Legends|listening devices]] and monitor Justicar communications. However, the Justicars had set up several [[Jammer/Legends|jamming devices]] that prevented Jaffkee from monitoring them. It was then that Jaffkee met a Republic individual who offered to assist Jaffkee in disabling the jamming devices.<ref name="SWTORnoise" />

{{GameLSmechanics}}
The individual was able to locate all the jamming devices and destroy them. That allowed the CSF's listening devices to come back online. Jaffkee reported his success to his superiors at [[Coruscant Security Force Headquarters|CSF Headquarters]].<ref name="SWTORnoise" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Well, with so much money going into the military, we don't get much in terms of funds or manpower.|Agent Jaffkee|<ref name="SWTORnoise" />}}
Jaffkee was a younger man with [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and light-colored skin. Dedicated to his job and displaying enthusiasm for it, Jaffkee remained at his post in the Justicar sector despite the constant threat of discovery and ultimately death. Though he remained brave, Jaffkee held a healthy awareness of the dangers and knew not to mess with the Justicars and to avoid their patrols as much as possible. Despite his young age and enthusiasm, Jaffkee displayed the characteristic bitterness<ref name="SWTORnoise" /> of many of the CSF's younger officers and recruits.<ref name="SWTORcsf" /> The resentment came about as the Republic put greater emphasis on allocating [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]] and manpower for the [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] and not the CSF. And, while Jaffkee was determined to complete his mission, he did not possess the support or manpower to do so on his own.<ref name="SWTORnoise" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jaffkee appears in the mission "White Noise" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] by [[BioWare]] released in [[2011]]. The mission is available only to Republic-sided players and can either be completed for [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] points or refused for no points.<ref name="SWTORnoise" />
